## Ctx.audioCaptionPayload() method

Route function for audioCaption with payload match intent `this.data.name`

**Signature:**

```typescript
/** @virtual */
audioCaptionPayload?(): Promise<any>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;any&gt;

## Remarks

Triggered by audio with caption and with payload.
